resources.string: Calls come to the app, and with notifications on, even when it is closed.
You do not receive calls. Turn this on when you are ready to help.
You cannot accept a call without the microphone: the blind person would not hear you. Allow the microphone.
Another volunteer has accepted the call.
You accepted this call on another device or on the website.
The call is no longer waiting for an answer.
Another volunteer has already accepted this call.
You are already in a call.
The other person ended the call.
The call did not take place: the other person did not join.
From %1$s to %2$s (%3$s time) you do not receive calls. You can change quiet hours on the Ryadom website.
You receive calls at any time of day.
Quiet hours now: no calls until %1$s.
Allow the microphone: without it the blind person will not hear you.
Allow notifications: without them a call will not reach you when the app is closed.
Allow full-screen calls: otherwise on a locked phone a call comes as a regular notification.
This phone has no Google services, so calls come only while the app is open. You can also help from a computer on the Ryadom website.
Call notifications are not set up in this build of the app: calls come only while the app is open.
Could not set up call notifications: calls come only while the app is open.
A call will reach you even when the app is closed.
Waiting for the other person to join…
The other person disconnected. You can wait or end the call.
The connection to the call is lost. End the call.
No access to the microphone: the other person cannot hear you. Allow the microphone in settings.
If you chose the volunteer role by mistake, change it.
Until you sign in again, calls will not come to this phone.
Rings when a blind person needs help.
A blind person needs help over video. Tap to answer.
